How did Summit Travel Partners do on DFW.text:
AA revenue: $221,326 (Q3 2025) → $297,931 (Q3 2026), +$76,604 (34.6%).  
AA share: 46.3% → 53.5%, +7.2 pts.  
Fair share: 65.7% (Q3 2025), 63.7% (Q3 2026). Share gaps: -19.3 pts (Q3 2025), -10.2 pts (Q3 2026). Summit is Not ahead of fair share in Q3 2026.  
Source: ask_metrics, aa_demo.gold.sales_metrics.
sql:
WITH q AS (
  SELECT quarter, MEASURE(aa_revenue) AS aa_revenue, MEASURE(aa_share) AS aa_share, MEASURE(fair_share) AS fair_share, MEASURE(share_gap_pts) AS share_gap_pts
  FROM aa_demo.gold.sales_metrics
  WHERE agency = 'Summit Travel Partners' AND market = 'DFW-ORD' AND quarter IN ('Q3 2025', 'Q3 2026')
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT 
  quarter,
  ROUND(aa_revenue) AS aa_revenue,
  ROUND(aa_share * 100, 1) AS aa_share_pct,
  ROUND(fair_share * 100, 1) AS fair_share_pct,
  ROUND(share_gap_pts, 1) AS share_gap_pts,
  ROUND(aa_revenue - LAG(aa_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY quarter)) AS aa_revenue_yoy_change,
  ROUND(try_divide((aa_revenue - LAG(aa_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY quarter)),LAG(aa_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY quarter)) * 100, 1) AS aa_revenue_yoy_pct,
  ROUND((aa_share - LAG(aa_share) OVER (ORDER BY quarter)) * 100, 1) AS aa_share_yoy_change_pts,
  CASE WHEN share_gap_pts > 0 AND quarter = 'Q3 2026' THEN 'Ahead of fair share' ELSE 'Not ahead of fair share' END AS fair_share_status
FROM q ORDER BY quarter

Which agencies are about to churn?.text:
A proxy, not a prediction: agencies with year-over-year AA revenue decline and behind pace.

FareHub Online: 2026-09 AA revenue 337,460, 2025-09 AA revenue 453,672, YoY -25.6%, pace_pct 97.2.
Harbor Business Travel: 2026-09 AA revenue 330,114, 2025-09 AA revenue 394,909, YoY -16.4%, pace_pct 96.1.

Source: ask_metrics, tables aa_demo.gold.sales_metrics, aa_demo.gold.dim_agency, aa_demo.gold.agency_pace (query for sales_month 2026-09).  
Could not verify: true churn labels or a churn prediction model in the data; those are needed to make actual churn predictions.
sql:
WITH rev AS (
  SELECT `agency`, ROUND(MEASURE(`aa_revenue`)) AS aa_revenue_2026_09,
         ROUND(MEASURE(`aa_revenue_prior_year`)) AS aa_revenue_2025_09,
         ROUND(MEASURE(`yoy_revenue_pct`) * 100, 1) AS delta_pct
  FROM aa_demo.gold.sales_metrics
  WHERE sales_month = DATE '2026-09-01'
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT a.agency_name, r.aa_revenue_2026_09, r.aa_revenue_2025_09, r.delta_pct, p.pace_pct
FROM rev r
JOIN aa_demo.gold.dim_agency a ON a.agency_name = r.agency
JOIN aa_demo.gold.agency_pace p ON p.agency_id = a.agency_id
WHERE p.sales_month = DATE '2026-09-01' AND p.goal_year = 2026
ORDER BY r.delta_pct ASC
